THE POST FOR WORK

MECHANIC AGRICULTURAL

3.1.1 WORK PROCESS

The mechanic agricultural performs agricultural works (ploughing, preparing seed bed (discussed, scarified), sowing, crop maintenance (weeding), fertilized, herbicided, freed land from plant residues, operations of machinery repairs, grain transport, fertilizers, materials), internal work and cleaning.

3.1.2 THE COMPONENT ELEMENTS OF THE EVALUATED WORK SYSTEM

MEANS OF PRODUCTION

  • Tractors U 650;

  • Sowers;

  • MA – for spreading chemical fertilizers;

  • Car herbicide;

  • Disks;

  • Harrows;

  • Sowers;

  • Combiners;

  • Rollers;

  • Trailers;

  • Fuel;

  • pesticides, herbicides;

  • Garbage;

  • Byproducts;

  • Products agricultural.

THE PREGNANCY FOR WORK

• Performs agricultural work mechanized: ploughing, preparation of the seedbed (discus, scarified), sowing, crop maintenance (sowing), fertilized, herbicided and freeing the land of plant residues.

• Drive, maneuver and operates tractors, agricultural machinery and assemblies tractor-trailer, both in the premises and on the agricultural lands, as and on access roads or public roads, as the case may be.

• Mount, connect, disconnects, adjusts and checks equipment and devices related to the machinery before starting work.

• Execute the transport cereals, fertilizers and necessary materials the activity.

• Perform operations of maintenance and repairs to machines and subassemblies, including operations with hand tools, the drill, the grinder and after case, welding works.

• Handle parts, subassemblies, wheels, materials and agricultural products within operations, maintenance and repairs.

• Use and manipulate fuels, oils, greases, pesticides, herbicides and fertilizers in specific activities.

• Performs internal work and cleaning, as well as preparation and maintenance operations of the workplace in appropriate condition.

THE ENVIRONMENT FOR WORK

• The activity is taking place both in the open air, on agricultural land and access roads, as well as in the tractor cabin and in the areas or spaces where perform maintenance and repair operations.

• The air temperature varies depending on the season, with high values in summer and low values in winter, the worker being exposed to the climatic conditions specific to the activity outside.

• Drafts may occur, including as a result of the leaky cabin of the U 650 tractor.

• Noise is present in during the operation of tractors, machinery and equipment, with some short-term exceedances of the value of 87 dB(A).

• The vibrations are generated by the operation of the machines, the movement on uneven ground and lack of suspension.

• In the atmosphere they can exist pneumoconiogenic dusts (dust), especially when moving on the road, to agricultural works and loading or tipping operations.

• Gases may also be present toxic vapors resulting from the use of phytosanitary products, as well as gases and vapors specific to welding operations.

• Microorganisms may exist in suspension in air resulting from the handling of natural products vegetation, as well as dangerous animals or insects (rats, dogs, wasps).
